narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to parts of southeastern Pennsylvania during the early hours of June 9. Rainfall amounts as high as 1.5 to 2.5 inches fell in a short amount of time.
ev: Light rail service was disrupted in Darby due to high water on the tracks.
